nodes.label: Separate home and party views
nodes.rationale: Home provides Create and Join tiles; the party view groups the shared screen, source selection, room details and chat. Native dialogs provide room creation/joining, party menu, help and invitation surfaces.

nodes.label: Shared player and custom transport surface
nodes.rationale: The party UI supplies local and YouTube player containers, host-labeled playback/seek controls, viewer-local audio and fullscreen controls, a user-gesture playback gate and visible player error/retry controls.

nodes.label: Video upload and YouTube source forms
nodes.rationale: Source controls include MP4/WebM/OGV file selection, upload progress and cancellation, and a YouTube URL form. Markup advertises the default 2 GB limit.

nodes.label: Accessible party-chat markup
nodes.rationale: Chat provides a focusable polite live log, empty state, unread-message button, labeled textarea, count, send button and expandable emoji picker. Controls begin disabled before a room is joined. The displayed limit is 1,000 while textarea maxlength is 2,000 UTF-16 units.

nodes.label: Room code, participants and LAN invitation UI
nodes.rationale: Room panels and party menu expose codes and participant lists. The invitation dialog selects among reachable network addresses and copies an invite link; help instructs guests to share the local network and keep the host server running.
